rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Adult fireworks cannot be sold to anyone under 18.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Adult fireworks are category F2 and F3 products.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Category F4 fireworks may only be used by professional display operators.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Fireworks must not be set off or thrown in streets or other public places.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: The normal night-time restriction is 11pm to 7am.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Bonfire Night use is permitted until midnight.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: New Year's Eve, Diwali and Chinese New Year use is permitted until 1am.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Private-use fireworks may be sold by registered sellers from 15 October to 10 November.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Private-use fireworks may be sold by registered sellers from 26 to 31 December.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Seasonal sales also cover the first day of Diwali or Chinese New Year and the three preceding days.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: An all-year sales licence is required outside the permitted seasonal periods.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: A storage licence is still required even where an extra seasonal sales licence is not.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Manufacturing fireworks requires an HSE licence.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Storage of up to 2,000kg net explosive content at many retail or wholesale premises is licensed by the relevant local authority or fire service.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Storage or sale above 2,000kg net explosive content requires HSE licensing.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Non-professional displays should provide adequate spectator space and a fallout area away from the audience.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Display organisers should select fireworks appropriate to the available site and safety distances.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Licensing authority and exemptions depend on net explosive content, hazard type, location, duration and purpose.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Local restrictions and licence conditions may be stricter than the general national rules.

rows.source: GOV.UK and HSE fireworks law and safe storage
rows.verified: Fireworks law and display guidance are activity-specific controls and not an exact parcel-level safety probability.
